notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the update 1.1.0.
This is big update, as the main mechanics have been changed significantly:
-Now the character isn´t locked in the middle of the scene anymore, they can now move freely through the park and kill the reptilians happily.
We think the game is more fun this way, so we hope you guys like this change.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25856299/c735ab3a9a7cef68b5626e181dcd916986f02da5.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25856299/539d7f6c4a90662febf7681dee1380dfe25add8f.gif[/img]

-Two new reptilians have been added. The first one, the sapper, will leave mines along the scene. Evil mines created by the illuminati, so be careful with them.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25856299/67bcea143b2cc57b75c534365334fb3a8605b1e5.gif[/img]

The other new reptilian comes also from the army. He will crowl towards the character to eat them. Media, entertainment, the army... Reptilians are everywhere.
-New vehicle, a shooting one: The Reptilian Army Jeep. It is fast, but weak.
Look how Ron takes care of one of them:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25856299/a84112947765226e0c0bad5c9546ace6be894471.gif[/img]

-Two new achievements: Collect 10 or 25 Bitcoins in a game. Bitcoins will appear in the scene, be fast an collect them.
-We have improved the visual quality with some soft camera effects.
-And finally, we have rewritten some parts of the code, so the performance has been improved. But if you have a low-spec computer and are not still able to killl reptilians smoothly, try with the "Good" quality setting in the start popup.

If you like the new update, a review will be welcome.
Thank you all for playing our little game, and remember:

[b]The New World Order must be stopped![/b]

notes.title: Reptilian Rebellion 1.0.1!
notes.notes:
Reptilian Rebellion has just been updated.
Change log:
-Improved performance.
-Slight bloom effect on camera.
-Forces 4:3 screens to 16:9.
-Responsive GUI on title screen.
-Fixed numeric intro key shot bug.
-Easier UFO achievement.

Thank you for playing and remember:

Reptilians are real and rule the world.
